ng-add.description: Transforms an Angular project into a Lynx-native application

add-tailwind.description: Adds Tailwind CSS with @lynx-js/tailwind-preset to an existing project

add-testing.description: Adds the AngularLynx Testing Library, which `ng test` sets up for rendering components on Lynx

add-i18n.description: Adds Angular i18n support with @angular/localize and provideLocale() to an existing project

component.description: Generates a component with Angular's component schematic, with a Lynx element template and LYNX_ELEMENTS imported

eject.description: Writes the generated iOS and Android projects into ios/ and android/ for native changes (one-way)
